title: Zavioli with Spinach and Ricotta
description: This recipe with ricotta cheese features strips of zucchini instead of pasta for vegetarian ravioli stuffed with spinach and fresh pesto.
ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, or more to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
To make the filling: Mix ricotta cheese, spinach, egg, and pepper in a bowl until well combined. Set aside.
To make the pesto: Grind basil, extra-virgin olive oil, and garlic into a chunky paste using a mortar and pestle. Add pine nuts to pesto; crush until nuts are coarsely ground. Set aside.

Slice zucchini lengthwise into 18 strips using a mandoline. Lay 2 zucchini strips in the shape of a cross on a work surface. Drop a spoonful of filling in the middle of the cross. Top with a dollop of pesto. Fold ends into the center to create a parcel, starting from the bottom end and moving clockwise. Secure with a toothpick. Repeat with remaining zucchini strips, filling, and pesto.

Spread a thin layer of pasta sauce in the bottom of a shallow baking dish. Arrange zucchini parcels on top, about 1/2-inch apart. Top each parcel with remaining pasta sauce. Sprinkle with Parmiggiano-Reggiano cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until sauce and zucchini begin to brown, about 20 minutes.

video.description: Go low-carb and keep all the great flavors you love with this delicious zucchini-spin on classic ravioli. Make a creamy filling with ricotta cheese, spinach, egg and pepper, then create a pesto with basil, olive oil, garlic and pine nuts. Once you slice zucchini into strips with a mandoline, and you’re ready for assembly! Spread pasta sauce in your baking dish, then arrange zucchini parcels stuffed with cheese mixture and pesto over the sauce. Spoon on more sauce, dust with Parmiggiano-Reggiano and bake until browned and tender.
